ROOT private sender-safety repair after A03 cancellation, no new application/lock/contentvote/main send. Prior helpers depended on assert for critical stop checks; under python -O those checks disappear. Own A02/A03 paths now have an explicit RuntimeError cancellation/released guard BEFORE any child/API/ref command. Original failed sender snapshots retained (.py.txt), originalSTATE and command receipts unchanged. Controlled -O stop checks on both cancelled routes exit1/CANCELLED_SENDER and exact STATE.json/SEND_COMMANDS.json hashes remain identical; cancellation is not revived.

Distinct private reusable gate validates literal commit bytes/OID/tree/exact ordered [expectedbase,sourcehead] parents, exact bool cancellation and integer zero request/unknown counters, then emits only one candidate:refs/heads/main with explicit expected-old lease. Ten meaningful tests pass normal AND optimized. Native disposable local bare-Git fixture tests healthy expected-old CAS success then competing-ref stale-lease rejection with endpoint unchanged; fixture reset uses force ONLY on a new private local toy repository, never GitHub/main. Every child argv/PID/UTC/full streams saved work/forward-cas-gate/RECEIPTS_{NORMAL,OPTIMIZED}.json. No original scientific producer/formal/GUI/model replay. New gate is private preparation, not a production runtime change or full sender/platform authority implementation; live source/votes/owner/rules/checks/reconciliation are still required. A01/A02/A03 remain cancelled/released, GitHub mainrequests0unknown0. Broad goal ACTIVE; no immediate fourth candidate rebuild.
